limits: Pokemon, Wizards and Konami do not print US MSRPs on their own product pages; Pokemon figures come from GameStop/Pokemon Center/TCGplayer/press lists.
Bulbapedia, pokemon.com, pokemoncenter.com, GameStop, mushureport.com were not retrievable (403 / Cloudflare / JS). I did not bypass the bot checks.

Several 'valid_from' dates for MTG sets (Foundations 2024-11-15, Aetherdrift 2025-02-14, Innistrad Remastered 2025-01-24, Spider-Man 2025-09-26, MKM 2024-02-09) are from general knowledge where the fetched source gave only an announcement date.
Products with release dates after 2026-10-20 (Pokemon 30th Celebration waves of Oct 30 / Nov 6 / Dec 4, OP-18, GD06, Star Trek) are upcoming.

game_notes: US MSRPs are not printed on pokemon.com; figures come from retailer/press lists (GameStop/Pokemon Center/TCGplayer) - labelled accordingly.

No US MSRP increase was found for 2024-2026 despite the premise. Evidence of increases is only: Japan JPY180->200/pack from May 2026 (https://www.toy-people.com/en/?p=107219), Australia ~+15% from 2025-03-26 (https://press-start.com.au/news/nintendo/2025/03/26/pokemon-tcg-price-increase-australia/), and retailer markups.
ETB pack counts: 8 (Sun&Moon 2017-02-03 ... Sword&Shield) -> 9 (Scarlet&Violet base, 2023-03-31 onward, incl. Mega Evolution). Pokemon Center ETB = 11 packs from SV base. Hidden Fates ETB had 10.
Bulbapedia, pokemon.com and pokemoncenter.com product pages were not retrievable (Cloudflare challenge / JS); I did not bypass the bot check.
